title: 2026년 11월 9일, 인공지능 분야에서 무슨 일이 일어났을까요?
intro: Agent safety was the day's dominant thread: new benchmarks and tools show permissions, provenance and isolation breaking once agents hold memory and shells, a week after a Firecracker guest escape.
Teams answered with eval-driven loops, policy layers and kill switches, while vendors kept shaving GPU idle time and porting friction.
highlights: Agent memory leaks confidential data in 67% of benchmark background tasks where raw RAG leaks 0%.
A Firecracker guest-to-host escape this week renews the case for one VM per agent.
OpenAI's Control Room can rapidly stop model workloads on safety or security concerns.
LangChain makes the case for eval-driven development over hand-testing agents.
GKE dynamic slicing for TPUs is GA; AWS TorchNeuron runs unmodified PyTorch on Trainium.
Anthropic recommends starting most builds on Opus 5.5 at medium effort.
